results.name: Paste Special ▸ All carries hyperlinks (plain, transposed, skip blanks keeps a target link under a blank source); openpyxl reads them
Values / Formulas / Formats leave the target's links alone (Excel keeps a link under pasted values) and never copy source links
Paste Link: absolute references (same sheet, other sheet, quoted names), follows source edits, blank source shows 0; openpyxl reads the formulas
